summary: You can move a Conditional Access policy straight to the stage you want.

new.title: Move a policy to any stage
new.text: A SuperAdmin can now move an adopted Conditional Access policy straight to any stage, up or down, or disable it. A move that skips stages says so.

new.title: Your Invardia environment name shown everywhere
new.text: The page header, alert mails and reports to Invardia now use the environment name Invardia keeps for your install. The Environment name setting is the fallback.

fixes.title: Move dialog shows real users and groups
fixes.text: The move dialog now lists the users and groups the policy covers, and no longer shows unchanged ones as a change.
